mentions.name: TisVlay
mentions.description: FOSS utility that brings TV display control to Linux, including power, volume, backlight, AV mute, and input switching, with per-device profile automation via desktop session integration (idle/lock, boot/suspend, remote login/streaming) and reverse control letting the TV lock, sleep, or wake the PC and its remote drive the desktop. Supports various vendor interface protocols for multi-display setups to mitigate energy usage, OLED panel burn-in, and projector bulb burn-out. Currently in beta but daily drivable and fully documented; ongoing work focuses on distro packaging and custom ATmega firmware in Rust for HDMI CEC USB adapters to work around TV firmware bugs.
mentions.problem: Personal pain points using HDMI TVs and projectors with PCs, including energy waste, OLED panel burn-in, projector bulb burn-out, and smart TV/projector spyware.
mentions.source_excerpt: TisVlay brings TV Display control for Linux, including: power, volume, backlight, AV mute, input switching plus more, with per-device profile automation via desktop session integration (idle/lock, boot/suspend, remote login/streaming, etc), and in reverse, letting the TV lock, sleep or wake the PC and its remote drive the desktop, while supporting various vendor interface protocols for multi-display setups, mitigating energy usage and OLED panel burn-in or projector bulb burn-out.
mentions.author: ruffsl
